title: [P2] create_record outputVariable may not be referenceable in later flow nodes (needs confirm)
body:
## Problem (needs reproduction confirmation)
Referencing a record created earlier in the same flow via its `outputVariable` may not resolve in a later node's interpolation.

## Observation
content `signal_to_topic_promotion`: `create_record` (topic, `outputVariable: 'topic'`) succeeds and the topic is created, but the following `update_record` setting `promoted_topic: '{topic.id}'` on the signal leaves `promoted_topic` null. Needs confirming against the working analogue (procurement `pr_to_po_convert` sets `converted_po: '{po.id}'`) to isolate whether created-record output is referenceable downstream.

## Expected
A `create_record` node's `outputVariable` (incl. `.id`) is referenceable in subsequent nodes of the same run.

## Affected
`@objectstack/automation`.


---
_Found while runtime-testing `objectstack-ai/templates` (all 9 templates via `objectstack dev all`) on `@objectstack` 9.5.1. Build + typecheck pass; these only surface at runtime._
